sourceProjection.basis: This unwarped derivative preserves the exact image placement of the cyan top-down structural overlay from UPC thesis page 50; the original page was visually inspected for the apse, repeated octagonal piers, side chapels and west entrance.

review: Original thesis page 50 image xref 104 was inspected at native 5159 by 2282 resolution; the retained original thesis SHA-256 is 7fc3848f35ba223860d8c2cf2639520105e632fa1a4ed24aed0130a886f985e5. The deterministic derivative retains source pixels where green-red and blue-red are each at least 8, abs(green-blue) is at most 50, and max(green,blue) is at least 80; it applies no morphology and removes only disconnected colour components below 100 native source pixels. Native-resolution comparison across delta 8, 10, 12 and 18 confirms that delta 8 best preserves the anti-aliased continuous outer perimeter, apse, chapel divisions and both octagonal pier rows without admitting the greyscale photomontage. No filled floor region is supplied because the source has no closed floor-fill path.
limitations: 本图为学术结构研究中的正投影复合平面，不是教堂当前访客导览图。
图中没有展厅编号；不补造编号，也不据此承诺礼拜堂开放状态或以近似多边形补画楼板。
玫瑰窗、搬运工浮雕与博恩一侧入口属于立面或未标注细部，均保持未绑定。
官网所列地下室、侧廊博物馆、塔楼及多层屋顶没有可核验正投影平面，本候选仅呈现教堂主层。
unresolved: 地下室：官网确认属于当前文化参观范围，但未找到带边界与入口关系的官方或测绘平面。
侧廊博物馆：官网确认属于当前文化参观范围，但未找到可定位展陈空间与通道的平面。
塔楼及多层屋顶：官网确认属于当前文化参观范围，但未找到各层正投影边界、楼梯落点或开放路线图。
主层礼拜堂逐间名称与当前开放状态：学术图只给结构轮廓，没有访客编号或现行开放标注。

research.result: Used: UPC thesis page 50 contains the native orthographic cyan structural overlay extracted by the pinned producer.
Official current visitor page confirms church interior, crypt, gallery museum, towers and multiple roof levels; it exposes no downloadable floor plan.
Official page locates the visitor information point and shop-bookshop in an apse chapel by the Passeig del Born portal, but provides no orthographic geometry or opening width.

UPC record documents a 2006 laser-scanning project and 2D orthographic products; the accessible article record did not expose a current visitor-floor set suitable for the missing crypt, gallery, tower or roof levels.

rasterLayers.reason: Native-resolution source-only cyan derivative of the reviewed structural perimeter, chapel boundaries and pier outlines; thin architectural lines remain flat detail instead of being promoted to masonry.
